title: ジャパンカップの後に・ここから！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week is defeated by El Condor Pasa, but the loss ignites a fire within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two vow to become even stronger as they leave the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, as Special Week heads home, Grass Wonder appears and challenges her to determine who is stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Special Week steps up to race against Grass Wonder the Beast at the Arima Kinen!
